# UI / Release / Deployment Continuation

## Observed delivery reality

- Branch: `main`.
- Remote: `origin -> https://github.com/awtsmoos/awtsmoos.com.git`.
- The shared worktree contains extensive unrelated staged and unstaged MitzvahWorld/server changes.
- `npm run ship` is forbidden for this release because `scripts/ship.mjs` stages the entire worktree.
- The repository deployment guide explicitly requires exact-file Git handling in a shared worktree.
- Canonical production activation is `scripts/production/remote-deploy-entry.sh <sha>` on the production host. It fast-forwards `/mnt/HC_Volume_102267213/git/awtsmoos.com` to `origin/main`, then calls `canonical-server-activate.sh`.

## Current structural evidence

JavaScript/MJS files are now at or below the 120-line source boundary. No compressed one-line method scan failures remain. Five first-pass CSS files remain over the boundary and must be rewritten into smaller responsibility-specific stylesheets.

## UI/UX refinement obligations

1. Strengthen mobile creation hierarchy around prompt -> mode -> references -> compact controls -> cost -> sticky generate.
2. Surface H3 mode constraints before the request: frame mode cannot mix with references; text mode has no references; adaptive ratio is tied to reference/frame workflows.
3. Make reference cards thumb-friendly, dense, and readable at 360px.
4. Improve active-generation visibility without blocking Create.
5. Improve creation-history scanability, status contrast, prompt excerpts, and build-from-this emphasis.
6. Improve Assets category/filter touch behavior and media-card metadata.
7. Improve Usage honesty and visual hierarchy for local recorded spend.
8. Improve Settings clarity for server connection, storage, cache policy, pricing provenance, backup, and destructive actions.
9. Make bottom sheets keyboard/safe-area aware and more polished on tablet/desktop.
10. Honor reduced motion and focus-visible states.

## Release graph

UI rewrite -> structural audit -> JS syntax/import tests -> targeted domain/proxy tests -> local server -> Chrome console + phone/tablet/desktop inspection -> fixes -> exact Olam diff review -> exact-path commit -> push `main` -> production SSH preflight -> canonical deploy requested SHA -> service/PID/hash checks -> public `/apps` and `/apps/olam-h3/` verification -> final remaining-work close.

## Git safety

Do not stage or commit unrelated paths. Do not use `git add -A`, `npm run ship`, or any reset/stash command. The Olam commit is restricted to:

- `geelooy/apps/olam-h3/**`
- `geelooy/api/olam-h3/**`
- `geelooy/apps/scripts/catalog/creation-ai.mjs`
- `geelooy/apps/scripts/catalog/creation.mjs`

The shared catalog file must be diff-reviewed before inclusion.

## Deployment gate

Deploy only the pushed commit SHA. Production canonical repo must be clean and on `main`. After activation, verify live PID, expected cwd, remote HEAD, HTTP success, app catalog presence, Olam H3 boot, no browser console errors, and safe missing-key behavior if production lacks `MINIMAX_API_KEY`.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite all remaining UI renderers/styles as readable mobile-first modules, then run the structural gate again.
